title: Historical research candidate common schema
purpose: Unify central-E-swap and scene-microgrammar outputs so research candidates can be compared, filtered, reviewed, and later bridged to the modern public generator without losing provenance.

field_definitions.operation: Generator operation that produced or selected the candidate.
field_definitions.host_source_id: Primary context source retained by the operation.
field_definitions.morphology_trace: Moved/fixed seam evidence and transferability scope.
field_definitions.scene_trace: Broad topic, narrow scene, evidence tier and gate outcome.
field_definitions.review_status: Research-stage status only; machine must not emit accepted/natural.

scene-microgrammar.donor_requirement: attested neighboring connections + curated scene compatibility

invariants: Source-specific seams remain source-specific in morphology_trace.
Missing evidence produces hold/review-needed rather than fabricated parse.
Public UI consumption is not implied by schema conformance.

minimum_before_public_bridge: Both v0.59 and v0.60 emit this common schema.
At least two positive scene families exist.
Public bridge only consumes explicitly whitelisted review statuses.
Modern-language adaptation rules are separate from historical-source claims.
